rationale: PR #321 proved that canonical Case A can select a qualification as direct_answer because explicit semantic priority is lost. This repair derives an answer role from existing governed topic-completeness metadata only when one published required component is unambiguous, preserves that semantic attribute through direct-fact reasoning, and renders the primary fact as an explicit DIRECT_ANSWER. Legacy response fallback remains unchanged.
authority_impact: No new product or claim authority is introduced. Answer role is deterministically derived from authoritative publication component identity plus the versioned topic-completeness definition. Ambiguous publications receive no primary role. The response assembler is unchanged.
